# Set pieces (generated by `python set_pieces.py --write-docs`; do not edit by hand)

Whole-scene Blender scripts for creature, herd, rider and ship scenes. The dinosaur and ship scripts end with `scene_kit.audit` (skin/skeleton size, action slots, floor contact, subjects in frame) and print `AUDIT ...` lines; an empty audit means clean. Preview with stills or `previs.open_viewer`, never mp4.

## The Last Egg (`last_egg`)

* script: `dino_scene.py`
* story: lion walks to a nest, picks up an egg, is chased by raptors, leaps onto a triceratops and rides through a swamp, a T-Rex roars, the egg is returned to the apatosaurus and glows (50 s, 9 cameras, sound)
* needs: assets/quaternius_dinosaurs_download (CC0 "Dinosaur Animated Pack - Dec 2018" by Quaternius, itch.io; ask before downloading); scenes/dino_assets (python build_leo_assets.py)
* known limits: the leap is an arc, the rider sits via the Sit clip, no biting or fighting contact
* prompt keywords: `dinosaur|dino\b|raptor|t-?rex|triceratops|apatosaurus|jurassic|prehistoric|volcano.*egg|egg.*volcano`

## The Storm Ship (`storm_ship`)

* script: `ship_scene.py`
* story: lion on a rocking ship climbs the mast, cuts a cloth sail, falls, fights a sea serpent, lightning ends it, calm (60 s, 13 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py)
* known limits: climbing is a walk cycle on a ladder, hands do not grip, serpent is chunky spheres, rain is thin
* prompt keywords: `\bship\b|\bsailing\b|\bpirate|sea serpent|kraken|storm at sea|\bmast\b`

## Horse herd (`horse_herd`)

* script: `horse_herd.py`
* story: aerial herd of 70 galloping horses along a river toward mountains (16 s, 5 cameras, sound)
* needs: assets/quaternius_farm_animals_download (CC0 "Farm Animals Animated" by Quaternius; ask before downloading)
* known limits: no riders, foals are scaled copies
* prompt keywords: `herd of horses|horse herd|galloping horses|wild horses|stampede`

## Rider on a galloping horse (`rider`)

* script: `rider_scene.py`
* story: rider mounts and gallops, jumps a fence, dust at every hoof, 7 cameras incl. rider point of view (22 s)
* needs: assets/quaternius_farm_animals_download; a built rider scene.blend (lion_source.blend or a quick_review shot)
* known limits: mount is a leap, legs are IK, hands do not wrap the reins
* prompt keywords: `ride[sr]? a horse|riding a horse|rider on|on horseback|horseback|mounts? (?:the|a) horse`

## Lessons (symptom, cause, rule)

| id | symptom | cause | rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| parent_inverse | Animals look thin and deformed ("sticks") once they run; fine in the source file. | Re-assigning mesh.parent in Python resets matrix_parent_inverse. The Quaternius files keep a x3.5 scale in that inverse, so the skin came out 3.5x smaller than its skeleton. | Save matrix_parent_inverse before setting parent and restore it (scene_kit.keep_parent_inverse); copies must copy it too. audit() flags mesh/skeleton size ratios outside 0.55..2.2. |
| gait_speed | Running legs blur into a strobing scribble. | Run clips were played at 1.35..1.9x; they are already fast (a 13 frame raptor cycle is 0.54 s). | Play clips at 0.8..1.2x (stride_play_speed) and derive ground speed from stride length instead of speeding the clip up. |
| action_slots | An action assigned in Python does nothing (static rest pose). | Blender 5 layered actions need a slot: assigning action alone leaves slot None. | Set animation_data.action_slot / strip.action_slot = action.slots[0]. audit() flags strips without a slot. |
| absolute_paths | libraries.load fails with C:\assets\... not found. | Blender -b resolves relative paths against its own folder. | Pass absolute paths to Blender scripts (use pwd -W / Path.resolve()). |
| hidden_templates | Giant dark shapes fill the frame; wrong object is animated. | Template objects hidden with hide_viewport still render; a copy named like its template collides (Triceratops vs Triceratops.001). | Hide templates in viewport AND render and give them a T_ prefix. |
| asset_scene_clutter | A flat plane or grid slices through the scene and hides characters. | Lion asset scenes built by the pipeline contain Floor/Grid/Wall planes that travel with the character group. | Drop meshes named Floor*, Grid*, Wall*, Ceiling*, Rug* and camera/light/empty helpers when loading character assets. |
| climb_pose | Lion climbing looks upside down or lies flat on the mast. | Pitching the body 77 degrees turns the whole body horizontal, not the climbing direction. | Keep the body upright, lean ~0.2 rad into the mast, add rungs; the pipeline has no real climb clip yet (climb_stairs is a walk cycle). |
| floor_contact | A lying or falling character sinks into the floor. | Baked clips drop the hips below the root; foot-lock only handles standing. | Measure the lowest vertex of the largest skin mesh (face parts are static outliers) per frame and lift the root (scene_kit.ground_lift); audit() reports penetration. |
| moving_platform | Characters slide on a rocking ship. | World-space paths on a moving floor. | Parent actors and ship cameras to the platform and key everything in its local space; world cameras aim at an empty parented to the platform. |
| no_clipping | A body that follows its head (serpent) passes through hull, cabin and masts. | Positions come only from a path; nothing pushes them out of scenery. | Run every body point through push_out(p, r, solids) with boxes, cylinders and the hull; this is cheap collision response, use Blender Cloth/Rigid Body only where simulation is the point. |
| cloth | A sail cut loose looks like a rigid card flying. | Keyed rigid plane. | Real Cloth modifier, pin vertex group on the yard, keyframed pin_stiffness 1 to 0 at the cut, wind field with keyed strength, collision on solids, bake the cache before saving. |
| cameras | Camera sits inside a sail or sees only sea. | Camera offsets chosen without looking at moving geometry. | audit() checks at least one subject is in frame mid-cut; render a contact sheet of stills (workbench, 480 px) before reporting. |
| contact_audio | Footsteps and dust do not match the animals. | Constant-rate sound. | Sample foot bone heights per frame, take contacts, and use those times for dust, splashes and sound. |
| no_mp4 | Previews take minutes. | Rendering video. | Never render mp4 for previews; open the .blend with previs.open_viewer (closes earlier viewers) and check stills. |
| downloads | Assets missing on another machine. | Downloaded CC0 packs are not committed. | Ask before downloading, extract into their own new folder, never run code from them, list the pack and licence in the docs (set_pieces.py reports what is missing). |
